name: VolFavorite pooled (5 coins)
description: eth-volfav's method on all five 15-minute crypto markets (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE) with one rule: late in the window, if the market's implied volatility is far above a per-coin forecast from recent realized vol, buy the winning side. The entry bar is the same percentile of each coin's own history (top 15% weekdays, top 40% weekends), so it trades far more markets than the ETH-only strategy.
hypothesis: Kalshi's 15-minute crypto markets price short-horizon vol too high after volatile stretches, in every coin, not just ETH; takers on the other side pay for reversals that rarely happen. Development-data decomposition (research/): edge rises monotonically with the implied/forecast ratio percentile in all 5 coins (BTC included, smaller), is ~2x larger on weekends (Sat/Sun UTC, 8/8 months positive), and hour-of-day and price band show no stable pattern. Pooling the five coins gives ~2,600 markets/month at roughly +1c/contract in research fills. Wrong if the walk-forward is not promising (CI>0, >=60% months positive, positive at 2x latency), or per-contract edge falls under ~+0.5c once the book is walked, or the lockbox (Sep 1+) loses.
